newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Jiang calls for ideas on Taiwan unification.
newsitem.headline: China's Jiang calls for ideas on Taiwan unification.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin on Tuesday called on Taiwanese people from all walks of life to make suggestions on the reunification of the mainland and its island rival.
"We welcome Taiwanese people of all circles to raise beneficial ideas and suggestions on peaceful reunification," Jiang said in a speech broadcast on state television.

Achieving reunification at the earliest possible date was in the interests of both mainlanders and residents of Taiwan, which Beijing has considered a rebel province since the end of the Chinese civil war in 1949, Jiang said in his New Year's address.
The president and Communist Party chief told Taiwan's leadership, which Beijing has accused of covertly seeking independence, to work to repair strained ties.
"The Taiwanese authorities would be well advised to put the interests of the nation first and to stop all activities of splitting the motherland," Jiang said.
Long-tense relations across the Taiwan Strait plunged to new lows in March when Beijing held missile tests in the waters near the island during Taiwan's first direct presidential elections.
